# 1) Identify all reggae-genre songs across all playlists in Spotify library
page_limit=20
playlists=[]
page_index=0
while True:
    resp=apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(access_token=access_token,page_index=page_index,page_limit=page_limit,sort_by=None,query='')
    if not isinstance(resp,list) or len(resp)==0:
        break
    playlists.extend(resp)
    page_index+=1
    if page_index>100:
        break

all_song_ids=set()
for pl in playlists:
    for sid in pl.get('song_ids',[]):
        all_song_ids.add(sid)

print('playlists_count:',len(playlists))
print('unique_song_ids_count:',len(all_song_ids))

reggae_song_ids=[]
reggae_song_info=[]
for sid in sorted(all_song_ids):
    s=apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=sid)
    genre=str(s.get('genre',''))
    if 'reggae' in genre.lower():
        reggae_song_ids.append(sid)
        reggae_song_info.append({
            'song_id':sid,
            'title':s.get('title'),
            'genre':genre,
            'artist_ids':[a.get('id') for a in s.get('artists',[])],
            'artist_names':[a.get('name') for a in s.get('artists',[])]
        })

print('reggae_song_count:',len(reggae_song_ids))
print('reggae_song_ids:',reggae_song_ids)
print('reggae_song_info_sample:',reggae_song_info[:5])

# unique artists from reggae songs
reggae_artist_ids=set()
reggae_artist_names=set()
for info in reggae_song_info:
    for aid in info['artist_ids']:
        if aid is not None:
            reggae_artist_ids.add(aid)
    for aname in info['artist_names']:
        if aname:
            reggae_artist_names.add(aname)

print('target_unique_reggae_artist_count:',len(reggae_artist_ids))
print('target_reggae_artist_ids:',sorted(reggae_artist_ids))
print('target_reggae_artist_names_sample:',sorted(list(reggae_artist_names))[:20])

# Fetch all artists the user is currently following (paginated)
page_limit=20
page_index=0
following_artist_ids=set()
following_artist_names=set()
while True:
    resp=apis.spotify.show_following_artists(access_token=access_token,page_index=page_index,page_limit=page_limit,sort_by=None,query='')
    if not isinstance(resp,list) or len(resp)==0:
        break
    for item in resp:
        following_artist_ids.add(item.get('artist_id'))
        following_artist_names.add(item.get('name'))
    page_index+=1
    if page_index>100:
        break
print('following_artist_count:',len(following_artist_ids))
print('following_artist_ids_sample:',sorted([i for i in following_artist_ids if i is not None])[:30])

reggae_artist_ids = [13, 15, 18, 22, 30]
# Check which ones are already followed, then follow the rest.
results=[]
for aid in reggae_artist_ids:
    following_resp = apis.spotify.show_artist_following(artist_id=aid, access_token=access_token)
    following = following_resp.get('following') if isinstance(following_resp,dict) else None
    results.append(('status',aid,following_resp))
    if following is False or following is None:
        follow_resp = apis.spotify.follow_artist(artist_id=aid, access_token=access_token)
        results.append(('follow',aid,follow_resp))
    else:
        results.append(('skip',aid,following_resp))

print('results:')
for r in results:
    print(r[0], 'artist_id', r[1], '->', r[2])

# Summarize which were followed successfully by rechecking
recheck=[]
for aid in reggae_artist_ids:
    resp=apis.spotify.show_artist_following(artist_id=aid, access_token=access_token)
    recheck.append((aid, resp.get('following') if isinstance(resp,dict) else resp))
print('recheck:', recheck)
